doc.title: Bernard Purdie interviewed by Monk Rowe, West Orange, New Jersey, July 30, 2003

title: Closing thanks
summary: Rowe thanks Purdie and wishes him well on his book.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well I want to tell you it’s been a real privilege to talk to you today, and I have enjoyed it immensely.
I want to wish you the best on your book.
Oh I’m so happy. I really am. It’s nice.
Well thanks for your time today.
Thank you. My plasma as they say. Well that’s what I say. I still like that.
